dedupe_keys.name: itu r study group 3 databanks dbsg3 of radio wave propagation measurements

description: The DBSG3 databanks hold radio-wave propagation measurements that have been submitted to and accepted by ITU-R Study Group 3, the body that writes the P-series recommendations on how radio signals travel. They are the reference data against which ITU-R prediction methods are tested and revised, and model developers widely use them to validate rain attenuation and other models. The tables include long-term statistics of attenuation by rain and gases, scintillation and depolarisation on Earth-space (satellite) paths and on terrestrial line-of-sight links, clear-air measurements, terrestrial point-to-area field strength data and VHF and UHF broadcasting measurements, gathered by administrations, operators and universities around the world. Each table is looked after by a table keeper, and those who wish to submit or obtain data work through Study Group 3 correspondence groups, notably CG 3M-2 and, for point-to-area data, CG 3K-2; data files come with readme documents. Coverage: measurement sites worldwide over several decades, with tropical regions under-represented. Format and access: data files via the ITU-R website and correspondence groups, free to participants; access terms for others not stated. Caveats: heterogeneous sources and periods; some tables are only available on request. Simulation uses: calibration of rain fade and propagation models for satellite, microwave and broadcasting links under weather hazards, and validation of coverage tools. Related records: Recommendation ITU-R P.833 on vegetation and the OpenMRG microwave link data are related propagation resources.
